purpose: Publish a canonical restart point, exact duplicate-intake reconciliation, preserved P0/P1 evidence gates and a controlled current-main/transplant queue for linked Por Derecho workstreams, without promoting new evidence.
evidential_boundaries: The supplied files are byte-identical to canonical main copies and create no new evidence object.
A controlled continuity release does not certify the court-file denominator.
A located node closes only that node unless the controlling source proves more.
Favourable and neutral acts must remain visible.
Not located in the controlled corpus does not mean nonexistent.
Legacy PRs are compared with current main and are never wholesale-merged by default.
